props.description: True, the default, to draw a dismiss button.

props.description: The dismiss button's accessible name; defaults to "Dismiss message".

props.description: What happened, in the app's language and a few words. Required: it is the first thing a screen reader says.
props.name: title

props.description: Detail under the title: what to do next, or why.
props.name: description

props.description: Buttons or links for the reader's next step, drawn under the description in a wrapping row.
props.name: actions

props.description: The kind of message. Defaults to `default`; `danger` and `warning` are announced at once.
props.name: tone

props.description: An icon in place of the tone's own, or `false` for none. Left out, the tone's icon is drawn.
props.name: icon

props.description:
Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
This allows rendering existing components with built-in styles and behaviors
such as router links, animation libraries, and pre-styled components.

Requirements:

* You must render the expected element type (e.g. if `<button>` is expected, you cannot render an `<a>`).
* Only a single root DOM element can be rendered (no fragments).
* You must pass through props and ref to the underlying DOM element, merging with your own prop as appropriate.
props.name: render
